def clean(df):
    # Fix species label variants
    df['species'] = df['species'].replace({'Adeile': 'Adelie', 'Gentto': 'Gentoo'})
    
    # Fix island label variants
    df['island'] = df['island'].replace({'biscoe': 'Biscoe'})
    
    # Convert body_mass_g from text to numeric, handling commas
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
    
    # Remove out of range values for body_mass_g
    df = df[(df['body_mass_g'] >= 2500) & (df['body_mass_g'] <= 6500)]
    
    return df

def answer(df):
    result = {}
    # Calculate average body mass for each sex
    avg_by_sex = df.groupby('sex')['body_mass_g'].mean()
    
    # Convert to dictionary with proper formatting
    for sex, avg in avg_by_sex.items():
        result[sex] = round(avg, 2)
    
    return result
